name: Meshflow Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: Meshflow Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC). Its primary objective is to identify and execute a strategic business combination, which could take the form of a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or a similar transaction, with one or more target businesses. The company was established on July 22, 2025, and its principal operations are based in Chicago, Illinois.
